voice.settings.muted_talk_hint: Remind me when I talk while muted

Needs the “Priority speaker” permission in the channel; with push-to-talk the key also opens your microphone. On phones and tablets use the megaphone button of the call controls.

voice.settings.bg_quality_fast_hint: A lighter segmentation model and no mask smoothing: for weak machines, edges flicker more.
voice.settings.bg_quality_balanced_hint: The full segmentation model with smoothing of the mask over time: steadier edges at little extra cost.
voice.settings.bg_quality_high_hint: Stronger smoothing and a softer edge around you: the steadiest picture, costs a bit more GPU.
voice.settings.bg_limits: The background is detected in the browser and stays approximate: busy backgrounds, low light, hands and hair at the edges and things you hold can be blurred or show through. Even light from the front and a calm background help most.

voice.test.title: Connection test
voice.test.description: Checks which paths to this node's media server work from this device: UDP to every announced address, TCP and TURN. Nothing is sent but test packets.
voice.test.mode_explicit: The node announces the configured addresses {addresses}.
voice.test.mode_stun: The node detected its public addresses at start (STUN).
voice.test.mode_local: Development node: it announces its local addresses.
voice.test.hint.signaling: The signaling connection failed: the reverse proxy must forward WebSocket upgrades on /rtc to the node.
voice.test.hint.no_media: Signaling works, but no media path: the node's media ports are not reachable from here. See the rows below.
voice.test.hint.udp_public: UDP {udp} on this address is not reachable: forward the UDP range on the router to the host running the node and allow it in the firewall. From inside the same network the router also needs NAT loopback; without it, add the node's LAN address to TAVRN_RTC_ADVERTISE_IPS.
voice.test.hint.udp_private: A local network address: reachable only from devices in the same network as the node. Elsewhere this row failing is normal.
voice.test.hint.udp_v6: IPv6 is not reachable: this device may have no IPv6, or the host does not publish the UDP range on its global IPv6 (Docker uses a private IPv6 network by default) or the firewall blocks it.
voice.test.hint.tcp: TCP port {tcp} is not reachable: publish it from the container and forward it on the router like the UDP range.
voice.test.hint.turn_udp: The TURN relay over UDP is not reachable: publish and forward TAVRN_RTC_TURN_UDP_PORT.
voice.test.hint.turn_tls: The TURN relay over TLS is not reachable: the TURN domain must point at the reverse proxy, which terminates TLS on port 443 and forwards plain TCP to TAVRN_RTC_TURN_TLS_PORT.
voice.test.summary_ok: Voice and video can connect from this device.
voice.test.summary_no_media: Signaling works, but no media path does: calls will not connect from here.
voice.test.summary_no_signaling: The voice server is not reachable at all.

admin.bans_hint: Blocks a user or an entire domain on this node. Local accounts are disabled.
entitlements.limits_hint: Whole numbers; 0 = unlimited (retention: keep forever; files channels: 0 = off, 1 = on). Grants only extend, never shrink.
entitlements.plans_hint: Named bundles of limits, e.g. for subscriptions. Changing a plan changes every grant that uses it.
entitlements.plan_delete_text: Only plans no grant uses can be deleted.
entitlements.grants_hint: Give a plan and/or single limits to a user of this node or to a room, optionally until a date. Expired grants are ignored and removed a week later.
entitlements.grant_delete_text: The limits of {subject} fall back to the node defaults and other grants.
entitlements.subject: Subject

entitlements.overrides: Single limits (on top of the plan)
entitlements.effective_hint: What the node applies to a user and/or room: node default, the user's grants and the room's grants (room limits count the room owner's grants).

second_factor.passkey_hint: Fingerprint, face, PIN or security key; can also unlock your encrypted messages

totp.qr_label: QR code for the authenticator app
totp.manual: Can't scan? Enter this key in the app:

passkey.app_origin_refused: This node does not accept the app's passkeys yet: use your passkey on the node's page in the browser instead.

passkey.key_no_access: A security key is plugged in, but this system does not let the app use it. The app's help ("Passkeys on Linux") names the udev rule that allows it.
codes.title: Your recovery codes
codes.intro: If you lose your authenticator or passkey, each of these codes lets you sign in once. They are shown only now.
codes.confirm: I have saved these codes in a safe place
codes.file_header: tavrn recovery codes for {account} - each code works once
recovery_key.intro: This recovery key unlocks your encrypted messages on new devices. Only you have it: neither the node nor its operator can restore it.
recovery_key.warning: Write the 24 words down or store the file in a password manager. Without the key and without a trusted device, old encrypted messages cannot be recovered.
recovery_key.confirm: I have saved my recovery key
verify.title: Confirm your sign-in
verify.totp_intro: Enter the current code from your authenticator app.
verify.recovery_intro: Enter one of your recovery codes. Each code works only once.
verify.insert_key: To use your passkey here, plug in your security key.
verify.recovery_used: You signed in with a recovery code
verify.recovery_used_hint: Consider generating new codes or adding another factor in the security settings.
e2ee.setup_intro: Last step: end-to-end encryption is set up for your account. Save the recovery key below.
e2ee.unlock_intro: This device does not have your encryption key yet. Enter your recovery key (the 24 words or the compact string) or use a passkey.
e2ee.skip_hint: Limited mode: you can chat in unencrypted channels, but encrypted messages and history stay unreadable on this device until you unlock it.
e2ee.lost_key: I lost my recovery key – reset my identity
e2ee.reset_warning: A reset creates a new encryption identity and a new recovery key. Your existing encrypted history becomes unreadable for good, your contacts see "security key changed" and your other devices have to be unlocked again.
e2ee.banner_setup: End-to-end encryption is not set up for your account yet.
e2ee.banner_locked: Encrypted messages cannot be read on this device yet.
e2ee.error.recovery_key_invalid: That is not a valid recovery key. Check the words for typos.
e2ee.mls_error.catch_up_failed: The latest encryption changes could not be loaded, so nothing was sent. Check the connection and try again.
e2ee.mls_error.ghost: The conversation changed while you were typing: an unknown device joined. Check the warning before sending.
e2ee.error.recovery_key_wrong: This recovery key does not belong to your account or is outdated.
e2ee.error.passkey_wrong: This passkey cannot unlock your messages.
e2ee.error.no_recovery_entry: Your node has no recovery key entry for this account. Reset your identity to continue.
e2ee.error.no_passkey_entry: This passkey is not set up to unlock your messages.
e2ee.error.identity_mismatch: The stored key does not match your account's published identity. It was not used.
e2ee.error.already_set_up: Encryption is already set up for this account. Unlock with your recovery key instead.
e2ee.banner_device_lost: This device lost its encryption keys, so encrypted messages and voice cannot work here. Sign in again to continue as a new device.
e2ee.device_lost_intro: The encryption keys of this device are gone: its local data was deleted or did not survive (for example when the system ended the app). A device keeps its key for good, so your recovery key cannot bring this device back. Sign in again: you continue as a new device, unlock it with your recovery key, and your messages and history stay readable.
e2ee.device_lost_skip_hint: Limited mode: you can chat in unencrypted channels, but encrypted messages and voice stay unavailable on this device until you sign in again.
e2ee.error.device_key_lost: This device lost its encryption keys. Sign in again to continue as a new device.
e2ee.error.state_unreadable: Stored encryption data could not be read. It was kept unchanged; reload the page to try again.

security.totp_remove_text: Confirm with your password. This only works if you keep another factor.
security.passkey_added_unlock: Passkey added; it can also unlock your encrypted messages
security.passkey_remove_text: Remove "{name}"? It can no longer be used to sign in or to unlock your messages.
security.prf_hint: Supports the PRF extension and can unlock your encrypted messages on new devices
security.prf_can_enable: can unlock messages: not enabled yet
security.prf_enable_hint: Confirms once with this passkey and stores your message key wrapped for it, so it can unlock your encrypted messages on new devices.
security.prf_enable_locked: Unlock the encrypted messages on this device first; then this passkey can be enabled.
security.prf_no_output: {name} returned no PRF output here, so nothing was stored. Try again on a system whose authenticator supports the PRF extension.
security.prf_none_hint: This authenticator returned no PRF output here: the passkey signs you in but cannot unlock your encrypted messages. Most FIDO2 security keys support the extension. Once the authenticator gains it (a system update), try again.
security.prf_none_windows: Windows Hello reports the PRF extension only on Windows 11 24H2 and 25H2 with the February 2026 update (KB5077181) or newer; Windows 10 never does.
security.prf_try_hint: The authenticator did not report the PRF extension when this passkey was created. Some report it only when used: "Enable message unlock" tries it once with this passkey.
security.codes_hint: Single-use codes for signing in when your authenticator or passkey is not at hand.
security.codes_regenerate_text: New codes replace all old ones. Confirm with your password.
security.encryption_hint: Your messages are encrypted with keys that only your devices hold.
security.e2ee_none: Not set up on this device
security.recovery_key_hint: Your recovery key is never stored, so it cannot be shown again. If you lost it or suspect someone saw it, create a new one; the old key stops working.
security.recovery_key_new_text: Your encrypted history stays readable; only the key to unlock it on new devices changes.
security.recovery_key_saved: New recovery key saved; the old one no longer works
security.lock_on_close: Require the recovery key or a passkey every time
security.lock_on_close_hint: Only on this device. Closing or reloading the tab or closing the browser locks your encrypted messages; the next start asks for the recovery key or a passkey. Useful on shared computers.
security.lock_on: This device now locks when closed

legal.not_published: This document has not been published.

legal.notice.title: Report illegal content
legal.notice.intro: Use this form to report content on this node that infringes your copyright, is illegal or breaks the terms of service. No account is needed. The operator reviews every notice; you receive a case number by e-mail.
legal.notice.disabled: This node does not accept notices through this form. Use the contact in the imprint.
legal.notice.basis.terms: Breach of the terms of service
legal.notice.work_hint_copyright: Identify the copyrighted work (title, author, where the original is published).

legal.notice.good_faith: I believe in good faith that the reported content is illegal or breaks the terms of service.
legal.notice.accuracy: The information in this notice is accurate and complete.
legal.notice.perjury: Under penalty of perjury, I am the owner of the exclusive right that is allegedly infringed or authorized to act on behalf of the owner.
legal.notice.signature_hint: Type your full name as electronic signature.
legal.notice.privacy_hint: Your details are used to handle the notice. They may be passed to the uploader in a counter-notice procedure and to the node hosting the content when it is on another node.
legal.notice.received_hint: We sent you a confirmation with a private status link by e-mail. Keep the case number for your records.
legal.notice.err_work: Describe the reported work or content.
legal.notice.err_explanation: Explain why the content is illegal or breaks the terms.
legal.notice.err_signature: Sign the notice with your full name.

legal.terms.required_text: You can continue using this node once you accept the current terms of service.

legal.terms.changed_register: The terms of service changed meanwhile. Please read and accept the current version.

legal.counter.sent: Counter-notice sent. The operator decides on it.

legal.delete.text: Your account is deleted immediately and you are signed out everywhere.
legal.delete.always: Always deleted: profile, devices and keys, sessions, backups, friends, direct-message memberships, applications.
legal.delete.kept: Your messages stay visible as "Deleted user" without name, avatar or link, unless you delete them below.
legal.delete.grace: The node admin can undo a mistaken deletion for 30 days; after that your username becomes free.
legal.delete.federation: Other nodes are asked to delete your data as well; they decide themselves.
legal.delete.messages: Also delete my messages and files
legal.delete.messages_hint: Their content is removed; conversations keep a "message deleted" placeholder.
admin.legal.documents_hint: Written in Markdown, published as sanitized pages at /legal/<kind>. Every publish is a new version.
